articles.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design

articles.title: macro-inc/macro
articles.excerpt: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.

articles.title: semantica-agi/semantica
articles.excerpt: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
articles.summary: 基于图原生的基础设施，为 AI 系统提供上下文管理与可问责性。通过图结构组织信息，让 AI 的决策过程可追踪、可追溯，适用于需要严谨上下文和合规审计的企业级 AI 应用。

articles.title: stablyai/orca
articles.excerpt: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and VPS.

articles.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
articles.excerpt: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

articles.title: Everything we launched during Agents Week
articles.excerpt: Our latest Agents Week has come to a close. Here’s a recap of all the announcements we made from Wallets to Radar.

articles.title: Serving the most critical missions: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status. We also announce our commitment to pursue DoD IL4 authorization. Cloudflare brings world-class security, performance, and developer products to the public sector.

articles.title: Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is shifting bot mitigation from point-in-time Risk assessment to continuous Trust evaluation. Learn how new good and bad behaviors from bots and agents are assessed by our systems, including BotBase and Precursor — and try out our Precursor Trace simulation to see how your own cursor move

articles.title: Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Radar Researcher is a new AI-powered tool that lets you explore global Internet trends and traffic data using plain language. Built entirely on Cloudflare's Developer Platform, it turns natural language queries into real, interactive charts.

articles.title: Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
articles.excerpt: We are launching updated community programs, including Cloudflare Ambassadors and Community Engineers, backed by $1M in open-source funding. Learn how we are supporting maintainers and scaling our developer community.

articles.title: Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is unifying AI Gateway and Workers AI into a single control plane, giving developers observability, billing, and dynamic routing across both managed GPUs and external providers. Learn how unified bindings and model-first routing simplify building resilient AI applications.

articles.title: Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data
articles.excerpt: AI Search makes search easier than ever, with no Cloudflare primitives to stitch together. Point it at your data to create a search for your own files and websites. We're also sharing a preview of our new pricing model.

articles.title: The next generation of MCP
articles.excerpt: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

articles.title: From ranking to recommended: get your site ready to thrive in the age of AI agents
articles.excerpt: More than half of requests now come from machines, not people. Agent Readiness shows how well agents can discover and read your site, while Answer Engine Optimization tracks how often AI assistants recommend you.

articles.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
articles.excerpt: Agents are a new kind of visitor. They don't render CSS or click ads, but they have a paying human on the other end. Block them and you block your customer. We're building the open tools and protocols so publishers and agents can cooperate and not collide.

articles.title: Introducing Kitesurf: The agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers
articles.excerpt: We should be giving all agents tools that excel at what’s important for an AI model. Kitesurf is Cloudflare’s new stateless, highly scalable, and cost-effective web browser that runs entirely on top of Workers and was designed specifically for the Agentic Cloud.

articles.title: Give any website a WebMCP interface
articles.excerpt: Today we're launching a developer preview of WebMCP on Cloudflare. With one switch, any site becomes usable by browser AI agents — no new APIs, no origin changes — while the human stays in control and creators keep their traffic.

articles.title: Cloudflare is the only vendor named a Visionary in 2026 SASE and SSE reports
articles.excerpt: We're honored to announce that Cloudflare is the only vendor that has been recognized as a Visionary in both the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SASE Platforms and the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Service Edge reports.

articles.title: The Agent Access Model
articles.excerpt: The Agent Access Model proposes a new architecture to secure task-scoped agents using strict identity brokering, continuous mediation, and stateful trust.

articles.title: How we’re rethinking work at Cloudflare with Cloudflare OS
articles.excerpt: We built Cloudflare OS to equip our teams to safely rethink how they get work done with AI. articles.title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
